title: Pricing Methodology — The Re-Contract Rate on Residential Natural Gas Supply
content:
**Definition.** For a Residential Natural Gas Supply agreement re-contracted after rollover, the re-contract rate is the renewal rate stated in the final options notice of the expired term, carried at four decimal places. It is stated in US dollars per therm and rounded half up to four decimal places.

### Inputs and their records

| Quantity | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| Final options notice of the expired term | the most recent final options notice on the agreement's notice history |
| Renewal rate | the renewal rate per therm stated on that notice, in US dollars to four decimal places |

The final options notice also states a month-to-month rate for the first cycle after expiry; that is the rollover rate, a different figure from the renewal rate.

### Worked figure (hypothetical notice)

The expired term's final options notice offers Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 12 at a renewal rate of 0.7990 per therm and a month-to-month rate of 0.9150. The re-contract rate is 0.7990 per therm.

### Basis questions

- *Which notice is read?* The final options notice issued for the expired term, which is the most recent final options notice on the agreement.
- *Which figure on that notice?* The renewal rate per therm, to four decimal places.
